explanation: An agreement or bond between God and people, often involving promises and conditions.
To show compassion, grace, and love, especially toward those who suffer or are in distress.
To be generous and willing to forgive faults and shortcomings, as well as to give unearned gifts and blessings.
To have great patience and endurance, particularly when tolerating the mistakes and weaknesses of others.
That which is correct, real, and reliable; in a religious context, it can also refer to God’s unchanging and eternal nature.
An action, thought, or attitude that breaks God’s will and moral law, leading to separation from God and other people.
A consequence or response to sin or an unjust act, often given by God to correct the situation and teach the guilty party.
Flat stone slabs on which God wrote the Ten Commandments, received by Moses on Mount Sinai as part of the covenant between God and the people of Israel.
